nodes.label: High resolution electron tomography for accessing Pt and ionomer distribution on carbon aggregate
nodes.description:
High resolution electron tomography for accessing Pt and ionomer distribution on carbon aggregate
Owner organization: CEA
Task: T1.3
Maturity: unknown
Documentation: 
Range of validity or processability: 
Sub nanometer resolution. The analysed volume may  not be representatif of the CL. An ultra-thin ( less than  1 nm) ionomer layer may not be visible on a porous carbon support. The image of the ionomer and the carbon support should have a different contrast (this is not the case with an amorphous carbon support).
internal key: High resolution electron tomography for accessing Pt and ionomer distribution on carbon aggregate0

nodes.description:
Electrospray deposition of Catalyst Layers
Owner organization: CIEMAT
Task: T2.4
Maturity: established method
Documentation: DOI: 10.1021/acsaem.1c01445
Range of validity or processability: 
- Coating area: up to 50 cm2  - CL thickness: up to 0.1mm - Substrate limitations: small electrical conductivity must be provided (dry Nafion PEM is OK) - Ink recipe: adjusted for each catalyst type (solid/liquid ratio, ionomer)
